result.title: Fusion Gains Depend on the Implementation and the Calibration Target: An 18-Task Study of Prediction Intervals with a Single-Source Fallback
result.comment: 4 figures; supplementary material included as an ancillary file
result.summary: A fused model can benefit from an extra learning stage as well as from a second data source. We compare four fusion implementations with matched single-source learners on 18 regression tasks with prediction intervals. Across ten refits under group-wise calibration, linear stacking improved the interval score by 6.0% against a source model without a second stage and by 0.1% against its matched single source. The four implementations agreed on 3 of 18 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 12, including 8 of the 10 tasks with naturally distinct sources. With pointwise calibration, they agreed on 5 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 9. A development-set selector with a matched single-source fallback improved ten-refit task-averaged scores by 2.2--6.3% in every implementation under both calibrations. Adding fused arms to the pool of single-source candidates improved the mean relative score by about 5 percentage points. Under group-wise calibration, the gradient-boosted selector met the criterion frozen before evaluation on eight held-out tasks. In post-opening refits, selectors lost to the matched single source in 4.4--6.1% of task-level runs under group-wise calibration. Under signed pointwise calibration, three implementations lost in 19--23% of runs. Fusion evaluations should compare matched candidates on held-out data and report how often the selector loses alongside its average gain.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 18 个回归任务上比较四种融合实现与其匹配的单源学习器，考察 group-wise 与 pointwise 两种校准目标下的预测区间表现，并检验带单源回退的开发集选择器在留出任务上的平均增益与失败频率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「匹配候选对比＋留出集选择＋同时报告选择器落后频率」的评估协议，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理相对基线的增益是否稳健、以及校准口径如何改变结论。
